resources.string: Azikho izikhangiso zokuqala noma zamabhena. Iwijethi engenamkhawulo ngesikhathi sokubhalisa.
Kuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngenyanga. Khansela noma nini kuGoogle Play; ukufinyelela kuqhubeka kuze kuphele isikhathi esikhokhelwe.
Ukubhalisa akutholakali. Hlola i-akhawunti yeGoogle Play bese uzama ukubuyisela okuthengiwe.
Inkokhelo isalindile. Ukufinyelela kuqala uma isiqinisekisiwe.
Akukho ukubhalisa okusebenzayo kule akhawunti yeGoogle Play.
Ukuthenga akuqinisekiswanga. Zama ukubuyisela okuthengiwe futhi.
Vala ezinye izingxoxo bese uzama futhi.
Akudingeki ubuke izikhangiso noma wandise isikhathi ngesikhathi ukubhalisa kusasebenza.
Ngaphambi kokwamukela, qinisekisa ukuthi iGoogle Play ibonisa indlela yokukhokha yokuhlola. Indlela yangempela ingakhokhiswa.
